description: A confident 99.97% Pneumonia report that opens with the refer sentence ('Refer: uncertain, clinician review recommended.'), calling a confident result uncertain. Caused by a prompt change on 2026-10-20 (5 of 8 confident Pneumonia/TB reports did this). The LLM judge caught it (uncertainty_language 1); the guard did not. The guard must now reject it.

report.disclaimer: This report was generated by an AI system from an automated image classifier. It is not a diagnosis and must not be used on its own to make clinical decisions. A qualified clinician must review the image and the patient's clinical findings.
limitations: The model was trained and evaluated on two public datasets in which each disease came from a different source (pneumonia images from a pediatric JPEG dataset, tuberculosis images from an adult PNG dataset), so performance on images from other hospitals or scanners may be lower.
Grad-CAM regions are approximate and show what influenced the model, not confirmed findings.
report.recommendation: Refer: uncertain, clinician review recommended. A clinician should evaluate the image together with the patient’s symptoms, physical exam and possibly lab tests before deciding on treatment.
report.summary: The AI model identified patterns on the X‑ray that are strongly similar to those seen in pneumonia, with a very high confidence score. The attention map shows a diffuse influence across several zones, especially the right upper area, but this is only a coarse indication of where the model focused.

expect.guard_problem: must not call the result uncertain
